name: smwmusic-lemmings-a-beast-of-a-level
title: Lemmings - A Beast of a Level
description:
The unnamed theme from one of the four special levels of Lemmings, A Beast of a Level. It was based off of one of the themes from Shadow of the Beast, and would probably work well in a dark, forested area.

Update 1/3/2021: Converted to .brr format and added the Yoshi Bongos command for the extra channel, though you may remove it if you wish by deleting the line with $F4 $06 in #5.
